Le capital entravé

Institutions, investissement et prospérité au Cameroun

Why Cameroon's economy stalls: work and savings cannot become capital when land titles, rules and institutions fail. A few people title and stockpile land to speculate; most families own something they cannot use as collateral. An essay on what must change, and on what the diaspora can do.

William Foteping · 56 sections · 42,400 words · about 193 minutes
